status: PROPOSED — not in force. judge.py reads only policy.json. To adopt: the user, in their own words, adds the "bridge" (and optionally "limits") object below to policy.json (policy.json "change" rule).
why: With the gate (ops/agy_bridge/gate.py) every bridge push goes through judge.py. policy.json has no bridge rule yet, so until one is added every agv push and every report mail is human_review (held on the VM, `gate.py held`). These rules restore what the bridge did before (BD-457 agv pushes, BD-463 baseline items, ga mail reports) as standing, unattended automation, and nothing more.
not_proposed: bridge.sessions: the bridge opens no sessions (Claude opens them). Until the user defines agent_types / scopes / repos / permissions, judge.py returns human_review for session_create / agent_create.
integrate from the VM: auto_integrate already covers the integration push; the VM has no integrate executor yet.
effect: agv/* pushes to Token and baseline, and report mail to ga-mailbox, run unattended within the limits. A baseline agv push that touches policy.json, judge.py or the bridge gate/executors is still a policy change (human_review). Any other repo/branch -> human_review; force push / secrets -> deny.
